title: Parameter - Javascript comment
description: Inserts the parameter into a javascript comment, i.e. /* %q */
php:
Parameter - Javascript Comment

The q parameter is inserted directly inside a multi-line JavaScript block comment /* ... */.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Check the page source to view the injected comment:

The comment is in the script block.
objectives: Break out of the JavaScript comment block using */.
Inject and execute valid JavaScript code.
hints: Close the comment: */ alert(1); /* or */ alert(1);//.
